about: Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited is an integrated piping solution & multi polymer manufacturer. It was established in 1987 and initially manufactured PVC products. It is currently engaged in the manufacturing of polymer piping solutions in four types of polymers CPVC, UPVC, HDPE, PPR. [1]
